title: F-Zero

masks.why: the speed, power and time display above the horizon is BG3 laid out for 256 columns on a 32-tile map that would repeat

issues: The track (Mode 7) continues to both edges, and the skyline above it repeats seamlessly.

Sprites are filled in the sides: the game parks its unused sprites (the CHECK sign, the rank and lap icons) just off the SNES picture, where the side columns would show them. Rival machines therefore appear only in the centre.
The display above the horizon keeps its 256 columns (BG3 filled in rows 0-46).
No flicker: in the 6,750 frames checked the game never drew more sprites on a line than a SNES shows, so it changed nothing; it changes only lines over the limits.
Fast CPU ran the 6,750 frames checked; the attract races play differently.

verified.how: Workshop --wms-test (E6), 6,750 frames of the attract demos in lockstep with the SNES console: widescreen's centre 256 columns identical to the SNES picture every frame, STAT77 and the sound identical, switched off frame-identical; no flicker changes only lines over the SNES's limits; better sound changes only the sound.
